title: atrium connector vendors
description: Who owns which product names, for atrium's Official tier. scripts/build-registry-digest.mjs carries each vendor in the registry digest as a {"vendor": …} line and the generic words as one {"genericWords": …} line; earlier builds skip both. A server named for a word a vendor owns is Official only when that vendor published it from one of its roots.

genericWords.description: Words no registry domain's name makes a brand: a reviewed core (ai, api, app, …) plus the everyday words registry domains are named for, which scripts/refresh-generic-words.py recomputes from the digest. A vendor's, a listing's or a preset's word overrides it.

owns.description: Its product words: no one else's server named for one is Official. Distinctive names only; an everyday word (zoom, slack) only after a review of what else it would demote.

searchedAs.description: A word its servers are also found by on a root whose name doesn't say it (google for googleapis.com). One of owns.

root.description: A registrable domain as a registry namespace (com.salesforce for salesforce.com), or io.github.<organization>.

source.description: Where the vendor shows it publishes from there: its docs, or the domain itself.

url.description: The exact endpoint, served from someone else's host (a docs platform, FastMCP, a Lambda URL). Never a whole host.

source.description: A page on one of the vendor's own domains that names this exact URL.

endpoints.description: Exact endpoints the vendor owns on someone else's host: a server there is judged as published from the vendor's first domain.
